name: cloud-keyring
description: Secure SSH public key directory for Cloudflare Pages and Workers

scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply cloud-keyring --local -c wrangler.worker.toml
scripts.db:migrate:worker: wrangler d1 migrations apply cloud-keyring --remote -c wrangler.worker.toml
scripts.db:migrate:pages: wrangler d1 migrations apply cloud-keyring --remote -c wrangler.toml
